looks.caption: Tier corporate: approved left, this build right. Floor lit only by the lamps: cold white arrow windows, gold lane and sling lamps, globes, insert light on the plates. Models are still stand-ins.
Tier street: approved left, this build right. Dusk general light, sodium lane lamps, the red beacon at full as a true light.
Tier office: approved left, this build right. Fluorescent general light, warm lane and sling lamps, bumper lamps.
Proof: tier corporate with every group, then lit by each of its ten groups alone (general, lanes, three inserts, two globes, windows, display, flash).
